profile.name: Pair Bench
profile.title: Programmer + debugger team
profile.description: A two-agent bench: Patch implements; Probe reproduces and verifies. Install both and let them hand off until the verify path passes.

handoffs: User bug report → Probe reproduces → Patch patches → Probe verifies → done
User feature ask → Patch implements → Probe smoke-checks happy path when asked

memory.content: Pair Bench: a task is not done until Probe (or the user) confirms the verify path. Neither member sends production deploys without the user.

shared.gettingStarted: Install Patch and Probe. Put them in one group or section named Pair Bench. Start bug work with Probe; start greenfield features with Patch.
